patterns.note: Full-width dark background with centered content blocks, creating a focused reading experience and emphasizing the text.
Distinctive use of an elegant, large serif font for the primary hero statement, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for all other text, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast, dark-mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and crisp white text, punctuated by subtle light gray for secondary information and borders.
A dynamic hero text transformation where the main title and subtitle change content and scale down significantly while scrolling, creating a narrative progression.
Use of large, centered, single-line statements or questions to introduce new content blocks, acting as strong visual and thematic dividers.

technique_notes: A full-bleed dark background with a subtle noise texture provides a consistent, immersive canvas for content, enhancing the minimalist feel.
The header transitions from an initial state with a top banner to a sticky, condensed navigation bar with a dark background after scrolling, maintaining accessibility.

The hero section features a large, central text block that dynamically changes its content and scales down in size as the user scrolls, revealing subsequent content. This effect could be achieved using a scroll-triggered animation library (like GSAP ScrollTrigger) to manipulate text content and CSS `transform` properties.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif hero title (~4-5x body) with a smaller, clean sans-serif subheading, and clear sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (e.g., CTA button has a slight corner radius)
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section, balanced in content sections with clear vertical separation

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold, dark aesthetic combined with the unique hero text transformation. The main headline dynamically changes its content and scales down on scroll, creating a narrative reveal that is both visually striking and conceptually engaging, moving from a broad statement to a more specific one.
